consequence.aftermath: You gave us a direction. I will use it for the people still here.
consequence.essence: Orion’s deliberate connection grounds acceleration; speed serves a chosen purpose.
consequence.gray: Juno pauses, chooses her vector, then accelerates; electricity remains her own.
